records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2021 was $288.0 million, an increase of 10.4%, or $27.1 million, compared to $260.9 million for the three months ended September 30, 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in net revenue was driven by sweet baked goods net revenue, which increased $24.7 million or 10.6%, led by gains in the club, dollar, convenience, drug and grocery channels with continued momentum of single-serve products driving favorable product mix.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During 2021, we continued to experience strong demand in our multi-pack products, as well as an increase in our immediate consumption single-serve business as mobility increased.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit for the three months ended September 30, 2021 was $99.0 million, with gross margin of 34.4%, compared to $91.2 million, with gross margin of 35.0% for the three months ended September 30, 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2021 and 2020 were $147.6 million and $108.0 million, respectively.
